cohort: 200 subjects planned for primary cesarean section out of 700 institutional deliveries at a hospital in Patna, Bihar, India
finding: The incidence of primary cesarean section was 28.57%, with the most common fetal indications being Non-reassuring or Abnormal CTG (54%) and Malpresentation (24%), and the most common maternal indications being maternal request CDMR (47.5%) and Abnormal placentation (25%).
